_doc: CB Insights enrichment for the Investor Map, fetched 31 Oct 2026 through the CB Insights connector (get_company_investments, get_company_profile). Keyed by directory id, or by the investor name as it appears on a deal. cbi.url is the citation. deals: [date, portfolio company, round, amount USD or null], newest first, at most 8 and biased to health, fitness and consumer rows. Counts are from the rows returned (10 per investor requested), so n is a floor, not a total. Re-run with the connector or the CB Insights API when the directory grows. cb: Crunchbase profile (cb_expert_resolve_entity) for the most active investors; stages are Crunchbase investor_stage buckets (seed, early, late, pe, debt, venture); permalink gives https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/<permalink>.
